title: PeonPing notification, sound, and PM plan comparison

peonping_findings.summary: PeonPing maps coding-agent events to CESP sound categories: session.start, task.complete, task.acknowledge, input.required, task.error, resource.limit, and user.spam.

PeonPing exposes setup/CLI controls for volume, categories, packs, per-pack sound enable/disable, desktop notifications, overlay/standard notification style, notification position/dismissal, templates, preview, and mobile push.
PeonPing keeps sounds, desktop popups, and mobile push as independent controls rather than one notification switch.
PeonPing supports mobile notifications via ntfy.sh, Pushover, and Telegram, but current inspected sources did not show Slack or Discord channels as built-in PeonPing destinations.
PeonPing supports local/custom pack ideas through sound pack install/use/bind, local pack install, disabled per-sound entries, MCP play_sound, and trainer custom voice-line folders.

PeonPing includes focus/meeting/headphones/silent-window/subagent suppression controls that are useful noise-governance patterns for PM, but should be adapted into PM attention-routing authority rather than copied as hook-script config.

pm_plan_findings.summary: PM already has a shared notification routing policy for Dashboard Action Required, thread badges, run-graph badges, toasts/banners, tray/system notifications, rate-limit banners, blocked versus attention-required copy, and canonical owner route preservation.

PM already includes optional sound effects through rodio, but only as a narrow accessibility-boundary requirement and audio module layout/risk; it does not specify user-uploaded sounds, sound packs, normal vs custom vs PeonPing sound libraries, or per-destination settings.

PM already has adopted HITL/run-complete notification requirements and a run-complete opt-out setting in Assistant Chat, plus GitHub Actions notification prefs for failure/success; these are not a unified notification center or cross-channel delivery matrix.

Search did not find canonical Slack, Discord, PeonPing, OpenPeon, ntfy, Pushover, or Telegram notification integrations in live non-ledger Plans; `webhook or push notification` appears only as aspirational/not-MVP for remote Git fetch.

recommended_pm_direction: Add a unified Notification and Sound Settings surface in GUI, not scattered per-feature toggles.
Keep existing PM attention-routing semantics authoritative; external channels are delivery destinations, not owners of alert truth.
Support destinations: in-app toast/banner, system/tray notification, sound, Slack webhook, Discord webhook, and a generic webhook/mobile-push extension point.
Support built-in normal notification sounds, PeonPing/OpenPeon-compatible sound-pack import or source-lineage adaptation, and user-uploaded custom sounds.
Do not bundle third-party/game voice packs unless licensing is explicitly verified; user-imported packs should be treated as user assets.
Store webhook credentials/secrets through PM secret storage; never log webhook URLs/tokens or expose them in exported ordinary settings.
Add preview/test affordances for every destination and sound mapping, plus accessibility/noise controls such as quiet hours, focus/DND respect, and per-event severity defaults.
open_product_questions: Which `etc` notification destinations are MVP beyond Slack and Discord: generic webhook, ntfy, Pushover, Telegram, email, or mobile push?
Should PM ship any PeonPing-style sound packs by default, or support PeonPing/OpenPeon-compatible imports while shipping only clean built-in normal sounds until licensing is verified?
Which events should make sound by default versus require opt-in?
Should notification/sound settings be global-only initially, or global defaults plus per-project overrides?

accepted_resolutions.resolution: MVP planning includes generic webhook plus mobile push candidates ntfy, Pushover, and Telegram in addition to Slack, Discord, in-app toast/banner, system/tray, and sound.
exact_tokens: we can add ntfy/pushover/telegram as well.

accepted_resolutions.resolution: PM supports PeonPing/OpenPeon-compatible pack import and user-provided PeonPing packs while shipping only clean built-in normal sounds until licensing is verified.

Sound defaults are on for input/approval required, blocked/escalated, failures, rate/resource limits, and long-running completion; routine run start, routine run complete, artifact published, and repeated-prompt/user-spam stay visual-only unless enabled.
Notification and sound settings use global defaults plus per-project overrides from the start.
